plugin.name: Remote VS Code
plugin.description: Seamlessly open a web-based VS Code workspace on any saved SSH host.

tab.title: VS Code
tab.noHost: Open VS Code from a host.
tab.launchingDetail: Connecting the SSH tunnel and waiting for code-server
tab.notInstalled: code-server is not installed on this host
tab.notInstalledDetail: Install it on the host, or set its path in the host's VS Code settings.
tab.chooseDetail: Pick one of this host's workspaces, a recent one, or type a path.
tab.pathLabel: Folder or .code-workspace file on the host
tab.missing: That path does not exist on the host
tab.missingDetail: {{path}} was not found. Pick another or fix the path.
tab.tooMany: Too many open VS Code sessions
tab.tooManyDetail: Close one of your VS Code tabs and try again.
tab.unsupportedDetail: {{path}} is a file. Open a folder or a .code-workspace file instead.

use.title: Use VS Code sessions
use.description: Start code-server sessions on hosts the user can connect to.

vscodePath.label: code-server path
vscodePath.description: Absolute path to code-server on the host. Empty detects it on PATH.

defaultWorkspace.label: Default workspace
defaultWorkspace.description: Directory opened when VS Code starts, such as ~/projects or /var/www.

workspaces.label: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Folders or .code-workspace files to open, one per line as Name = path. A line with only a path uses its last segment as the name. Lines starting with # are ignored.

palette.openAtPath: Open VS Code at a path…
